ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) dominant surface; high-contrast white-to-black pixel ratio is low, localized primarily to small-scale scarring and terminal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark grey/black base across both lobes; stochastically distributed high-intensity white circular spots (diameter 5-15 pixels) across the central surface; high-density, multi-tonal white/brown clusters at the lateral terminal boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped indentation with an approximate pixel angle of 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 10% of the fluke's vertical extent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency serrations; peak-to-valley amplitude varies between 5-20 pixels; notable jagged indentations present on the medial sections of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a broad convex curvature from the median notch, sweeping horizontally before curving upward at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters; solid white circular spots on the left lobe; hollow, ring-shaped high-intensity outlines (diameter 10-25 pixels) predominantly on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (white/grey) visible on the lower medial surface of the left lobe and lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at both lateral tips, appearing as dense, irregular, high-contrast jagged masses (Coronula diadema morphology).
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive hollow-ring scarring pattern localized on the central-right lobe surface.
